padding: Same physical basis/spacing; integer voxel bounds enclose original grid and all forward nodal coordinates, plus one exterior cell on every face.
scope: At every original target node, solve the current forward boundary-linear trilinear field equation with bounded Newton/backtracking. Compare storing those roots on the original or padded inverse lattice. Also solve directly at each forward-node query. Root convergence does not establish unique/global invertibility or cell topology. No optimizer or production source changes.
denominator: Both compositions keep every original target grid node; failed/unsupported roots and invalid compositions remain explicit.
baseline_requirement: Both r24 C4 forward residual hashes must match the historical topology diagnosis before attribution. Current stored inverse hashes are recorded separately because its exporter changed since that diagnosis.
